title: State the Pi belt's row set in the config reference and close the regen obligation
action: The config reference's Pi section describes the belt but states no row set, so a reader cannot tell which bee rules fire on Pi and which are deliberately excluded. Write that row set from the belt as it now stands, after the earlier cells landed: one row per wired rule naming the Pi event that carries it, and one line per excluded rule naming the reason. Derive every line by reading the belt, never from this plan or from memory, and resolve every path and command you write by opening or running it. Say plainly which rules exist on the Claude belt and have no Pi carrier, so the absence is documented rather than inferred. Keep bee mechanics out of the user-facing wording where a plain description serves. There is no doc-parity test to write here, so the proof is a recorded read: state in the cap which belt lines you checked each documented row against. Then close this feature's deferred regen obligation, since the belt file sits under a release-manifest root and the earlier cells deferred it to the wave barrier: run the regen chain and the release-manifest check, and carry the manifest record in this cell's changes.

truths: The Pi section states one row per wired rule with the Pi event that carries it
Every deliberately excluded rule is named with its reason, including the ones with no Pi analog
Every documented row was checked against the belt source, and the cap names the lines checked
The regen chain and the release-manifest check both pass and the manifest record is carried in this change

artifacts.substantive: a complete Pi row set with wired rules, their Pi events, and the named exclusions with reasons
regenerated record covering the belt change

key_links: every documented row corresponds to a runAdvisoryHook or pi.on literal in the belt
prohibitions: No row written from the plan or from memory instead of from the belt
No unresolved path or command in the prose
No new user-facing Pi surface documented that D2 forbids building

verify: cargo test --release --no-fail-fast --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml --test pi_plugin_contracts --test opencode_plugin_contracts && .bee/bin/bee dev release-manifest --check

deviations: The regen ran through /home/thanhsmind/.cache/cargo-target/release/bee instead of the vendored .bee/bin/bee, because the vendored copy is a symlink into the main checkout and is behind the source it would regenerate from; the write guard correctly refuses replacing it from this worktree — hit an unforeseen obstacle

mistakes.wrong: The documented line for session-close says it flushes state before compaction, but the PreCompact arm returns the undecidable value and does nothing observable except one stderr line
mistakes.better: the row should have described what the code does, not what the event name suggests

mistakes.wrong: The document lists state-sync on Stop under rules with no Pi carrier, which is false: agent_settled is a carrier and the belt simply never wires state-sync there
mistakes.better: this was the orchestrators planning miss surfacing in the docs, not the workers invention
